paragraphs.text: Riverbank Animal Shelter relies on volunteers to care for around 60 dogs and cats. Volunteers must be at least 16 years old, and those under 18 need a form signed by a parent.
New volunteers attend a two-hour introduction on the first Saturday of the month. After this, they can choose regular shifts of three hours, either in the morning or in the afternoon.
Tasks include walking dogs, cleaning animal areas and helping at adoption events. Volunteers do not give medicine to animals; this is done only by the shelter’s trained staff.
We ask volunteers to commit to at least one shift a week for three months. Unfortunately we cannot pay travel expenses, but volunteers receive a free T-shirt and a discount at the shelter shop.
If you would like to volunteer, please fill in the application form on our website. We will contact you within two weeks to arrange a place on the next introduction.

items.quote: those under 18 need a form signed by a parent

options.text: needs a form signed by a parent.
must work with an adult volunteer.

explanation.en: The minimum is 16, and “those under 18 need a form signed by a parent” → B. A is wrong: 17 is above the minimum age.
explanation.kk: Ең төменгі жас — 16, ал «those under 18 need a form signed by a parent» → B. A қате: 17 ең төменгі жастан жоғары.
explanation.ru: Минимум 16 лет, а «those under 18 need a form signed by a parent» → B. A неверен: 17 больше минимального возраста.

items.quote: they can choose regular shifts of three hours, either in the morning or in the afternoon

options.text: are in either the morning or the afternoon.

explanation.en: “shifts of three hours, either in the morning or in the afternoon” → C. Two hours (A) and Saturday (B) belong to the introduction.
explanation.kk: «shifts of three hours, either in the morning or in the afternoon» → C. Екі сағат (A) пен сенбі (B) кіріспе сабаққа қатысты.
explanation.ru: «shifts of three hours, either in the morning or in the afternoon» → C. Два часа (A) и суббота (B) относятся к вводному занятию.
